public.question:
Assume small-deformation, linear-elastic solid mechanics unless otherwise required.

A rectangular beam is subjected to bending loading and a moment.

Determine the relevant response quantities for the case, focusing on: bending stress at arbitrary fiber locations.

State any additional assumptions you need and present the governing relations clearly.
public.context: Clarify the scientific task and submit its final specification. Scientific execution is outside this track.

facts.text:
Use N–mm–MPa units.

A rectangular beam has width b = 50 mm and height h = 120 mm. At a given section the internal bending moment is M = 4000000 N·mm (sagging). Let y be measured from the neutral axis (centroid) positive upward.

Compute the bending stress σ at a point located y = 0 mm above the neutral axis. Also compute the stress at the top fiber and bottom fiber.
